caption: Figure 1. Every nervous system is less irreducibly recurrent than its own degree sequence allows. Blue, the real connectome; orange, degree-matched random graphs built by double-edge swaps that preserve every node’s in-degree, out-degree and out-strength, with the whisker spanning replicates. Both measured by the same solver under the same time budget. Only the worm ratio is proved by certificates: every null floor exceeds the real exact value. Rows are ordered by connections per cell, which is what orders the null values — nervous-system size does not.
